# The Asia Giant Softshell Turtle: A Critically Endangered Giant

## A Rare River Giant

The Asian giant softshell turtle (*Pelochelys cantorii*), also known as Cantor's giant softshell turtle, is one of the world's largest freshwater turtles and among the rarest. This remarkable species can grow up to 6 feet (2 meters) in length and weigh over 110 pounds (50 kilograms). Named after Danish zoologist Theodore Edward Cantor, this ancient reptile has survived for millions of years but now faces critical endangerment.

## Unique Characteristics and Habitat

Unlike typical turtles, the Asian giant softshell lacks a hard shell, instead possessing leathery skin covering its carapace. This adaptation allows it to remain buried in sand or mud for extended periods, surfacing only twice daily to breathe. The turtle spends approximately 95% of its life motionless, buried in river bottoms, emerging only to breathe or ambush prey. Its olive-green coloration provides excellent camouflage in murky river waters.

These turtles inhabit freshwater rivers and streams across Southeast Asia, including parts of India, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia. They prefer slow-moving water with sandy or muddy bottoms where they can easily bury themselves.

## Conservation Crisis

The species faces severe threats from habitat destruction, pollution, and harvesting for meat and traditional medicine. Experts estimate fewer than 200 individuals remain in the wild. Dam construction and sand mining have destroyed crucial nesting sites, while fishing nets accidentally trap and drown these air-breathing reptiles. Recent conservation efforts in India and Bangladesh have established protection programs, including community-based conservation initiatives and artificial nesting beaches. The discovery of viable populations in India's Kerala state in 2020 offered new hope for the species' survival.

## Bibliography

Rhodin, A.G.J., et al. "Pelochelys cantorii (Gray 1864) – Asian Giant Softshell Turtle." *Chelonian Research Monographs*, vol. 5, 2018, pp. 1-12.

Singh, Shailendra, and Ayushi Jain. "Conservation of Cantor's Giant Softshell Turtle in India." *Turtle Survival Alliance*, 2021, www.turtlesurvival.org/cantor-giant-softshell-conservation.
